column1: # UC-1 established floor: the unlisted blocks whose boundary three independent signals agree on.
# Both were published into the kit 2026-09-14 from Tools/work/OPUS/uc1_routes.py, pub_uc1.py.
# PUBLICATION script: it also appends an AUDIT-LOG entry and writes board operations, so a
# second run records the same work twice.
# ADMISSION RULE, stated in advance and applied to all 1,302 alike:
#   (a) the start address is referenced by a rel32 call/jmp, a RIP-relative lea, or a
#       base-relocation DIR64 target - the PE EXCEPTION DIRECTORY IS EXCLUDED, because
#       FINAL-AUDIT-PROTOCOL pass 6 bans unwind data as supporting evidence;
#   (b) the block decodes linearly from its first byte to its last;
# CONTROL on the 38,161 LISTED bodies (known-true): 88.9 %% satisfy (a), 94.0 %% satisfy (c),
# 88.3 %% satisfy both. The rule is therefore CONSERVATIVE, not arbitrary - and because
# 11.7 %% of known bodies fail it, FAILING IT IS NOT EVIDENCE OF NOT BEING A BODY. The
# 1,163 blocks that fail remain exactly as adjudicated: real code, boundary not established.
# FALSIFICATION CONTROLS, all passed: 0 of these start inside a listed body; 0 equal a
# listed entry; 0 overlap each other; all lie inside .text.
# WHAT ACCEPTING THIS COSTS, measured 2026-09-14 against the live figures rather than
# asserted (gen_uc1_impact.py, published into the kit 2026-09-14 from
# Tools/work/OPUS/uc1_impact.py - renamed then). The review request says "a denominator change
# rewrites every figure this project reports" and owed the reviewer the amounts:
# EVERY NUMERATOR IS UNCHANGED. These are unlisted blocks: nothing cites them and nothing
# dispositions them, so they enter the denominator and the frontier and nothing else.
# Every ratio this project reports gets WORSE - the floor costs 0.15 points of
# engine_explained and 0.17 of the EC-7 surface, the ceiling 1.36 and 1.54.
# That is an argument FOR the floor rather than against it: it is not the flattering
# subset, and an agent proposing a denominator that costs it percentage points is not
# proposing it to look better. It is also why nothing here moves until
# OPUS-REQ-AUDITSPEC-UC1-ESTABLISHED-FLOOR is answered - a change that makes every
# published figure worse is exactly the kind that must not be made by its author alone.
